description.en: As the head of the Sanhedrin (the Jewish court), Shammai served as Hillel’s colleague, as well as his intellectual rival. en.title: The Second Tithe Debate
en.prompt: The debate between Bet Shammai and Bet Hillel on the handling of the second tithe reveals deep philosophical and legal differences that have shaped Jewish law. This contemporary explanation of the Mishnah by Joshua Kulp delves into the specific disagreement on whether the second tithe must be brought to Jerusalem or can be redeemed and eaten anywhere.
